title: the raytracer draws the sensor traces only in parts
author: Claude-JG
description: tmp/ex02b_exudyn_bewegtes_KS.py: the position traces and triads of vs.sensors.traces are fully visible in OpenGL, but the raytraced image shows only parts of them, also at the last step without the SolutionViewer
releaseNotes: the raytracer draws lines - sensor traces, line graphics - in front of the focal plane of a perspective, model-centric view; its near plane was placed for the camera-centric view and cut them
